name: SPEC-P-001 live signup write delta against the hosted customer data map
summary: One real hosted TEST signup (attempt p001-datamap-dd5c74d9) and its cleanup, run against the live dev Postgres between 6 journey-free baseline windows on each side (20s each). pg_stat_user_tables write deltas were judged by the committed instrument packages/operator-core/lib/auth/hosted/customer-data-map-write-delta.ts: a written table falsifies SPEC-P-001 if the data map does not name it and it is either in the papercusp_auth customer schema, or neither written in a baseline window nor row-attributed to a declared fleet writer (every row the probe sees written in the journey window must match that writer). Verdict: FAIL; falsifying tables: 2; first-pass candidates 2, row-attributed 0. Limits: outside papercusp_auth, attribution is by time window plus per-writer row probes on a fleet-shared database whose writers all use one role. It can miss a hosted-path write to a non-customer table that the fleet also writes during the baselines. The per-transaction admission check in customer-data-map.integration.test.ts covers that path precisely.
